about: The names under which BRANCH finds each dataset it needs in one database. One file per database; docs/BRING_YOUR_DATABASE.md says how to write one. The names are tried in order, without regard to capitals, and the first that matches exactly one process wins; when several processes share a name and differ by location, location_preference decides.
citation: Life Cycle Inventory database of the Swiss Federal Administration, BAFU:2026
